parsed.rationale: All three type-alias-objects — `PlaybackBlendModeKey` (PlaybackBlendMode.swift:89), `MaterialBlendModeKey` (MaterialBlendMode.swift:89), and `OverlayBlendModeKey` (_Plant_OverlayBlendMode.swift:89) — are exact duplicates residing in the same `Wallpaper` package, all at line 89, with `shared_field_count: 1` and no differing slots. Because they differ only in the blend-mode domain they tag, a single generic `BlendModeKey<Mode>` type parameterised on the mode type would unify all three without loss of type safety. The three concrete aliases can then be re-expressed as `typealias PlaybackBlendModeKey = BlendModeKey<PlaybackBlendMode>` etc., preserving call-site compatibility while eliminating the structural duplication.
